name: STIHL MS 201 C-EM
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ lightweight bars on 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links (63 PM3), from STIHL's 2025 chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 201 C-EM is the rear-handle saw in STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart block with the MS 194 C-E, MS 194 T and MS 201 T C-M. That chart lists lightweight bars: 12″ with 44 drive links (63 PM3 44, bar 3005 000 7405), 14″ with 50 (63 PM3 50, bar 3005 000 7409) and 16″ with 55 (63 PM3 55, bar 3005 000 7413), all 3/8″ PICCO at .050″. The specification table on catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024, prints the chain type for the MS 201 C-EM as PS3 on 12–16″ bars, not PM3. PS3 at 3/8″ PICCO is the same .050″ gauge (STIHL code 3616) with a different cutter. This page's loop numbers are the recommended-loop chart. Read the cutter on the old chain if the box says PS3. The top-handle MS 201 T C-M has its own page from an earlier reading of a related block.
notice: The specification table names PS3. The recommended-loop chart names 63 PM3 for the same bar lengths. Pitch and gauge match. The cutter name does not.

bars.note: STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 63 PM3 44 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7405. The block header names the MS 194 C-E, MS 194 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M together. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 12″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 63 PM3 50 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7409. The block header names the MS 194 C-E, MS 194 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M together. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 14″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 63 PM3 55 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7413. The block header names the MS 194 C-E, MS 194 T, MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M together. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 16″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, read 7 Nov 2026. Drive links and 63 PM3 loop numbers from the guide-bar chart (catalog p. 166). The specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024) names PS3 for this model and 35.2 cc. File size from the catalog file table: 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO.
